decisions.reason: The candidate's existing message-128 INTRODUCE already records that the support-base branding and font color must match the supplied reference; the beige base color remains owned by the source color-scheme Requirement.
Matching the support base's beige shade and font color does not alter the DJ-turntable visual theme or decorative-control styling.
The support-base color and lettering decision does not change bowl capacity, depth, geometry, or enclosure-size constraints.
The source changes the support base's visual treatment, not the mixer's thickness, dimensions, or mechanical form factor.
Local context resolves the matching font color to the separate support base, not the machine placards or their text, placement, and viewing orientations.
The support-base appearance decision does not affect splash prevention, guards, bowl geometry, or high-speed mess control.
The source does not change bowl removability, swap speed, or removal clearance.
The support-base color and font decision has no effect on whisk detachment or tool-free removal behavior.
Although the support base accommodates the bottom-mounted spouts, matching its beige shade and font color does not change spout geometry, orientation, material, or mounting location.
The source concerns support-base appearance and does not alter mixing quality, foam performance, whisk selection, or whisk positioning.
The visual treatment of the support base does not affect electrical loads, controller capacity, power-supply capacity, or overload protection.
The platform's existence and cup-clearance function remain unchanged; its beige visual treatment is independently represented by the source color-scheme Requirement.
